reviews.review: game is absolute garbage.  still glitchy.  i mean buggy, not janky.  but its janky too.  which is fine i like that sometimes.  this game makes me want to play the surge 2.  never finished it.  i've lost my experience points several times from getting stuck and having like the most pathetic enemy block me into a tiny pebble as a corner and can't do anything but die basically.  i've had weapons delay to fire like i had to wind them up then die only to find out when i respawn that it fires right away with or without me having stamina so then i jus realize i lost my xp yet again for no good reason.  let alone the enemy and bosses will glitch facing an entirely different direction than you thought they were facing, making you waste your ammo as you think your shooting their weakspot.  i've had enemies just standing with back to me and as i fire my sniper from a distance they glide out of the way like when my finger presses half way down on the mouse button.  terrible game with much promise to be a janky gem but ultimately fails and leaves you feeling robbed.
game is like dark souls its a sure to test your skills. i recommend it dark souls guns nice for a change
